narrative.overview: Roleway feels like a personal workspace that happens to manage a job search, not a dashboard assembled from widgets. A warm-stone rail supports one paper-white work island; graphite typography and quiet neutral selection keep attention on the current opportunity and its next action.
keyCharacteristics: Flat persistent navigation beside one dominant work island.
Warm neutral architecture with blue reserved for action, progress, focus, and selected icons.
Document-like pages and record surfaces instead of dashboard card grids.
Compact, labeled navigation in expanded and collapsed modes.
Dark mode preserves the same semantic hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Saturated Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates action or progress. Navigation containers, page chrome, and decorative regions stay neutral.

rules.name: The One Island Rule
rules.body: The navigation rail belongs to the backdrop. Never place the sidebar inside a floating container or nest additional page-sized islands inside the main surface.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows explain hierarchy or movement; they never decorate static content.

dos: Do use proximity and hairlines before adding a container.
Do keep the next action and its due state visible near the record it affects.
Do reserve cards for movable opportunities, approvals, and self-contained records.
Do use blue for actions, progress, focus, and selected icons.
donts: Don't wrap the sidebar in a floating panel or give every section its own island.
Don't use blue-tinted application chrome, startup gradients, glass, glow, or decorative metrics.
Don't turn summaries into large dashboard cards or put empty-state icons in generic rounded tiles.
Don't copy Notion's brand assets or terminology.
